Demand thesis STRENGTHENED on every axis. Google Cloud +82% to $24.8B (meaningful acceleration from +63% Q1'26 / +36% FY2025); Cloud backlog/RPO $513.9B (+~$54B QoQ); Cloud operating margin 35.6% (from 20.7%) with op income tripling to $8.8B; Search & other +17% with AI features driving query growth (Gemini App 950M MAU; ~90% of Fortune 100 on Gemini Enterprise). The revenue mechanism (monetize commercial intent + sell AI compute) is more proven than in June. Already at the +2 ceiling; the open question is whether these dollars survive capex to reach owner earnings (that is M4).

Two offsetting moves. IMPROVED: the central incremental-moat test ('can post-AI-capex capital earn high returns?') got its first real yes -- Cloud held 35.6% margin across a second quarter with a $513.9B backlog; Search durability (+17%) confirms the existing moat. WORSE: capex guidance RAISED to $195-205B (2027 higher) into a NEGATIVE-FCF quarter with STILL no disclosed ROI hurdle (CFO 'attractive return' is a philosophy); 52.7% founder voting power now more salient with buybacks $0, $49.6B equity+preferred issued and debt doubled -> no external lever on the capex bet. Net held +1 (existing moat Strong and better-evidenced; incremental moat partly-but-not-fully proven; capital-allocation discipline still absent). Operator ~28/40.

WORSENED -1 -> -2: the prior dossier's warning MATERIALIZED. Q2 free cash flow went NEGATIVE -$5.9B; TTM FCF fell to $53.3B (-20% YoY, from $64.4B at Q1'26 TTM and $73.3B FY2025); capex a record $44.9B (115% of quarterly OCF; TTM capex/OCF 71.3%, crossing the 70% line); FCF/share $6.06 (FY25) -> $4.36 (TTM), -28%, while share count ROSE (12,088M -> 12,230M) with buybacks at $0 and $49.6B equity+preferred issued; LT debt roughly doubled to $98.2B. Meanwhile GAAP net income printed +298% on a $99.0B non-cash unrealized equity gain ($6.26 of the $9.11 EPS) -> reported income overstates owner earnings ~2.6-4.4x; TTM owner earnings ~$55-95B (cash read FCF-SBC only ~$23B). Not fraud and not a survival risk (liquidity huge), and Cloud (35.6% margin) is a real growth-read offset -- but the specific capex-black-hole mechanism has begun to realize, so the signal must worsen.

Held -1, but the picture clarified. The scariest PERMANENT path was F1xF3 confluence (AI erodes search AND capex balloons -> owner earnings permanently diluted). Q2 SPLIT the legs: F3 (capex black hole) MATERIALIZED (FCF negative), but F1 (search erosion) was DISCONFIRMED (Search +17%, AI additive to queries), and F2 (regulatory structural remedy) EASED (DOJ search resolved without a breakup; adtech judge skeptical of divestiture). A permanent impairment needs the search leg, and it is failing -> this is a capex/VALUATION trap made more acute, not a franchise-death spiral. Hence a haircut/size driver (-1), not a veto (-2).

runner_dissent: Recorded per protocol. This quarter genuinely improved the BULL case AND made the stock cheaper -- the missed-compounder risk is real and larger than in June. Cloud is now demonstrably converting capex into high-margin revenue (35.6% margin, op income tripled, $513.9B backlog, +82% growth), which is exactly the 'incremental ROIC holds' disconfirming evidence the June bear thesis needed; and the two scariest permanent paths (F1 search erosion, F2 structural regulatory remedy) both weakened. If Cloud keeps compounding and capex normalizes after the 2026-27 peak, the bull +8.2% could prove conservative and $317.69 defensible. The framework nonetheless HOLDS WATCH/0% (does not override to STARTER) because PRICE is still the constraint: the base-case 10y IRR is still NEGATIVE (-1.0%), only the bull clears 8% (so you pay full price for the optimistic case with no cushion), and this quarter the capex-eats-FCF thesis did not just persist -- it REALIZED (free cash flow went negative, FCF/share -28% from peak, dilution now naked, debt doubled, and management raised capex to $205B while still disclosing no ROI hurdle). A 14% drop that coincides with a 20% FCF decline is not a margin of safety. Wait for price (~$99-117), not for a better story -- the story is already good.
